title: Oozy Smoky Roasted Ceviche Avocado Skewers
description: Buttery, crispy Croatian dish featuring chopped chive and roasted avocados, perfect for a date night.

ingredients.name: date palm
ingredients.notes: pitted and sliced into small pieces

ingredients.name: garlic cloves
ingredients.notes: minced with some of the cilantro

instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat coconut oil over medium-high heat.
Add butter and smoked paprika; stir until fragrant.
Gently fold in the lime juice, cilantro, garlic, onion, and chive.
Fold in avocados gently to avoid bruising.
Place skewers of avocado on a preheated Dutch oven griddle at 200 degrees Celsius for 5 minutes each side or until golden brown.
Arrange skewers on a serving platter.
Dust with smoked paprika before serving.
